questions.question: At which ground did Eastern Storm record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Uplands College — largest win by runs of 218, against Rhinos on 2025/03/01.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Lanette Pienaar or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Lanette Pienaar: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: Nicolien Janse van Rensburg set a database record (24/25 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 2. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls', held by Nicolien Janse van Rensburg.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)' in the 17/18 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 70.

questions.question: Ayabonga Khaka has played 95 List A matches for South African provincial sides. How many T20 matches has she played, per this database?
questions.explanation: Khaka's List A to T20 ratio (95 to 19, roughly 5 to 1) is far more lopsided than most of her national teammates, several of whom sit closer to 1.5 to 1.

questions.question: At which ground did C Jansen record their career-best bowling figures (3-44, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Heat on 2019/11/30.
